skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Gate 3 — Profile the entity, then interview the user' marks close calendar, framework and soft/hard close as Required with no default, and owners as Recommended, but 'Step 3 — Assign owners and deadlines' and 'Output Quality Standards' ('Every task has owner, due date...') cannot be met on an upload run where they are unanswered; there is no instruction for presenting owner-less tasks.

SKILL.md 'Step 6 — Tie-out workpaper at close' calls inter-period continuity 'the most valuable item' and [auto], but the manual-run checklist never asks for a GL or opening-balance TB, so with two YTD closing TBs the check cannot run; the skill gives no manual substitute.

SKILL.md 'Step 1 — Build the close task list' Day 3 statuses are [auto] from journal entries; on the upload path the only evidence is TB movement, and the skill gives no rule for a self-reported log that contradicts the TB movement (only the inverse case in 'Edge Cases': 'A task marked Complete with no entry posted').
SKILL.md is a single 1,067-line file with the manual-run rules ('After an upload, validate the input before any work') embedded in the onboarding block rather than in a references file.
sample_defects: The key expects 'Software subscription recurring entry did not post in September', but trial_balance_2025-09-30.csv shows 6300 Software 31,500 vs 28,000 at 31 Aug (+3,500 = the subscription); 31,500 / 3,500 = 9 months, so the TB says it did post. Either the TB or recurring_entries.csv should be changed.
